turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What features are you hoping to see next?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Multi-speaker dialogue in a single generation call would save us so much post-production work. Right now we generate each character separately and stitch them together in an editor.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How much time would that save, roughly?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Easily half our editing time on multi-character chapters. That's probably 5-6 hours a week for our small team.
